mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as capital costs fall and risk appetite rises.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in falling FEDFUNDS periods shows no significant positive bias compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 3.5% signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 3.5%, 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate accelerating consumer demand, generating positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In inflationary phases (CPIAUCSL > 250), declining FEDFUNDS signals central bank intervention to prevent economic slowdown, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 250 periods with falling FEDFUNDS, 20-day returns are negative in > 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, generating negative S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: In INDPRO < 105.0 periods, 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return distribution in rising GDPC1 periods shows no significant positive bias (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market strength that increases consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In post-housing boom recovery (HOUST > 1200), rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates sustained consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In HOUST > 1200 periods with rising RSAFS, 20-day returns are negative in > 55% of cases.
